$comment: publish[] (#794) is the publish table: one unit per releasable package (the 21 SDKs of .sdks[] plus sdk-shared), each naming its gate, registry (or none, with a reason), coordinates, versionSource and the units it must follow (after). tagFormat is the one release-tag shape; tools/sdk-pack/resolve-publish.mjs is the only reader that decides whether a tag may publish. liveSuite.runner (#783) is the ONE command that runs an SDK's live wire-cases: it always goes through the harness wrapper (`--corpus-seed --exec -- <cmd>`), which boots the harness, exports CONFEATURE_LIVE=1 + LIVE_HARNESS_URL and passes the exit code through — so no caller can run a live suite that silently skips. contract-live.yml runs it; dagger livePythonContract reads python's from here. Single source of truth for per-SDK containerized test coverage (spec 053 Phase 5, #204). Consumed by .github/workflows/release-gate.yml and .github/workflows/sdk-publish.yml. status=covered SDKs run their daggerFn as a publish/release gate; status=pending SDKs BLOCK publish (no false-green); status=exempt SDKs publish without a gate (documented reason). Flip a pending entry to covered (with its daggerFn) when epic #354 containerizes it — both gates auto-enroll it with zero workflow edits. localGate (default true when absent): whether the SDK also runs in the LOCAL prepushAll suite. Tier-2 SDKs (java/dotnet/php/ruby/rust/dart) are covered but localGate=false — release-gate-only — because 6 heavyweight heterogeneous toolchain containers in parallel exceed the NFR-004 8GB local budget (they OOM the Dagger engine); this is the constitution v1.3.0 'demote the slowest tier to release-gate-only' clause. The release-gate runs each on its own CI runner, so no shared-memory OOM. android + kotlin-mp (#364) are also localGate=false: their shared androidSdkContainer is pinned to linux/amd64 because AGP ships only an x86-64 aapt2 (no linux-aarch64 build), so on an arm64 host it runs under emulation — too slow for prepushAll, fine for the release gate. ci (#793) is how .github/workflows/sdk-gates.yml runs an SDK on every push and pull request: an SDK with a daggerFn runs it as a Dagger leg (`gate (<name>)`); an SDK whose daggerFn is null carries ci.native instead, `macos` (built and tested natively on a macos-15 runner) or `smoke` (a labelled source-quality smoke, not a build). Every SDK has exactly one of the two (tools/repo-gates/verify-workflows.mjs rule 19). ci.knownRed: `#<issue>` marks an SDK whose first run is red with a defect too large for its child: its leg runs in gate-known-red, shown red with the ticket and not counted, and a pull request honours the waiver only as the BASE commit carries it (tools/repo-gates/select-sdks.mjs), so a pull request cannot waive its own red. ci.pending: `#<child>` is transitional: the SDK has no leg until that child of #793 lands, and `sdk gates` is red whenever it is selected, so every push to main stays red, visibly, until the last one is removed (#917). liveExempt: `<reason>` (#918) is why an SDK has no liveSuite, carried instead of a liveSuite with no runner.
